course.title: A community 5K/10K through Hytrol Industrial Park.
course.description: Participants can choose between a 5K or 10K through Hytrol Industrial Park in Jonesboro. Detailed route imagery was not available in the verified public race information, so this concept keeps the course section focused on confirmed race options and registration guidance.

runner_decision_checklist.headline: What runners and walkers need before signing up.
runner_decision_checklist.intro: A clear, phone-friendly summary of the date, location, event options, prices, packet pickup, and official RunSignup registration path.

items.label: Race date
items.detail: The race starts at 9:00 AM CST.

items.label: Start/finish area
items.detail: Race-day packet pickup is listed near the start/finish line directly in front of Hytrol.

items.label: Event options
items.value: Hytrol 5K, Hytrol 10K, and Spirit Runner support option
items.detail: The 5K and 10K are both listed with a 9:00 AM CST start; the Spirit Runner option is for non-participating supporters.

items.label: Current base prices
items.detail: RunSignup lists a price increase beginning November 2, 2026: 5K and Spirit Runner to $35, 10K to $50.

items.label: Packet pickup
items.value: Nov. 13 at Dan’s Health Club; race morning at Hytrol
items.detail: Early packet pickup is Friday, November 13 from 8:00 AM to 7:30 PM at Dan’s Health Club at Hytrol. Race-day pickup is Saturday, November 14 from 7:00 to 8:30 AM near the start/finish line.

items.label: Community beneficiary
items.detail: Race proceeds support affordable healthcare access in the community through JCHC.

items.label: Shirt deadline
items.value: Register by October 21, 2026 to guarantee a race shirt
items.detail: After the deadline, shirts are listed as first-come, first-served while supplies last.

story.title: Thirty years of movement, giving back, and community pride in Jonesboro.
paragraphs: The 2026 Hytrol Industrial Park 5K/10K marks 30 consecutive years of bringing the community together through running, walking, and giving back.
Participants can choose the 5K, the 10K, or a Spirit Runner support option, with registration continuing through the official RunSignup flow.
Proceeds benefit the Jonesboro Church Health Center, supporting affordable healthcare access for uninsured and underinsured community members.

schedule.name: Race-day packet pickup
schedule.location: Registration table near the start/finish line, directly in front of Hytrol

provenance.method: RunSignup Events and Race Date sections.

faqs.question: Where does registration happen?
faqs.answer: Registration stays on the official RunSignup page. This race website concept makes the event information easier to scan, then sends runners to RunSignup to complete registration and payment.

provenance.method: Registration CTA and RunSignup page routing.

faqs.question: Who benefits from the race?
faqs.answer: Race proceeds benefit the Jonesboro Church Health Center, which provides affordable healthcare services for uninsured and underinsured community members.

provenance.method: RunSignup Description section and corroborating Jonesboro Right Now article.

faqs.question: Are walkers welcome?
faqs.answer: Yes. Walkers are welcome in both the 5K and 10K.

faqs.question: When is the race-shirt deadline?
faqs.answer: RunSignup states that runners should register by October 21, 2026 to guarantee a race shirt. After that, shirts are available first-come, first-served while supplies last.

startline_value.headline: A dedicated race page that complements RunSignup.
startline_value.intro: This concept keeps registration and payment on RunSignup while giving runners a clearer, more polished place to understand the event before they click through.
improved: Places date, location, distances, pricing, packet pickup, and beneficiary details in one mobile-friendly path.
Presents the Jonesboro Church Health Center community story with more context than a registration-first listing.
Keeps repeated registration calls to action pointed at the official RunSignup registration flow.
paid_includes: Standard package recommendation: a polished dedicated race-marketing website with source-backed event sections and registration-click measurement.
Starter package fallback: a leaner launch page if the organizer wants to start with the essentials only.
No registration replacement, no payment processing migration, and no guaranteed growth claim.
